reproducibility_note: Restricted: trained at training_commit a34e992ed57dd7661ebff6d1c88ac3b75d47a0b5 on a corpus (gradientsports, skillcorner, sportec) that includes matches which cannot be redistributed or carries no public-visibility proof (variant 'restricted'), so the weights cannot be reproduced from public data (ADR-067 M4).

detection_selection_bias.note: Detected keeper frames are a SELECTION-BIASED sample (the camera sees the keeper when the ball is near him), so they over-represent the engaged/advanced keeper and under-sample the deep sweeper regime GKDV cares about. Depth = goal-relative x. This is a stated limitation, not a gate -- no rule in this cycle detects it. Both bias axes are measured here: keeper depth AND ball-to-keeper distance (goal-relative; detected frames are expected to show a SMALLER ball-to-keeper distance, which IS the selection mechanism). See spec 4.3 rev 5.
